title: All day: London 05:00-08:00 - lit (long-view pick)
question: Owner 2026-10-23: start trading 24/7 - which setups work in each part of the NQ day, at the same or a higher win rate than LIT?
notes: tools/allday.py, variant lit|london|0.5,0.8,8.0,1.5; picked: long-view pick (2021-24, plateau score)

rules: LIT exactly as live (engine/lit.py, live_model.json 'lit': inducement first, 5m CISD, limit 30 min, 1m CISD entry, stop 1 tick beyond the sweep extreme, VIX-band target, 15-minute check, BE + 1.25 pts, Monday rule, weekly stop), but entries only in London 05:00-08:00, 1 trade a day.
This window's own thresholds: sweep >= 0.5 ATR deep, displacement body >= 0.8 ATR, target banked at 8.0R, breakeven at 1.5R.
Flat 15:55 ET at the latest (an evening entry is held at most to 15:55 of its trading day).

method: LIT replay (engine/lit.py run_x, the same code as the live loop engine/lit_live.py): 2026 entries on 1-minute bars, 2021-25 on 5-minute bars (reference); live sizing + weekly stop; costs included
